title: Nkuri-Tomu village, near Giyani (approx.): woman, 35, shot dead at home; husband, 73, arrested, 13 Oct

story: Police say a 35-year-old woman was shot dead at about 11 pm on Tuesday 13 October at a house in Nkuri-Tomu village near Giyani. Officers on patrol received a complaint about a shooting and were directed to the house by the victim's brother-in-law; she was lying in the sitting room with multiple gunshot wounds to her head and upper body, with a steel axe and ammunition next to her, and was declared dead at the scene. Her 73-year-old husband was arrested at the house and a firearm seized; police say domestic violence has not been ruled out (police spokesperson Malesela Ledwaba, via Jacaranda FM). No one is named here. Two reports, both resting on police: Jacaranda FM and Daily Sun. The pin is approximate (village level).
incident: Tue 13 Oct 2026, at about 23:00 (police, via Jacaranda FM and Daily Sun)
reported: 15 Oct 2026 (Jacaranda FM, Daily Sun); SAPS Limpopo statement 14 Oct
location_note: At a house in Nkuri-Tomu village, near Giyani (police, via Jacaranda FM and Daily Sun). No address. The pin is the Ka-Nkuri village point on OpenStreetMap, inside the Giyani police precinct; approximate, village level (about 4 km). Tomu is part of the village name in the reports and is not separately mapped.

provenance.statement_from: SAPS Limpopo (media statement of 14 Oct), quoted by Jacaranda FM and retold by Daily Sun
other_voices: Lt-Gen Jan Scheepers, Limpopo provincial commissioner (condemnation)
provenance.note: Both reports retell the same police account; Daily Sun adds its own colour ("fear and shock") but no new source. Not independent of the police account.
